The **second‑largest island** in the world is **New Guinea**, and its highest summit is **Puncak Jaya** (Carstensz Pyramid).  
The elevation of Puncak Jaya is **4 884 meters** above sea level【1】.  

Thus, the highest elevation on the second‑largest island is **4 884 m**.
